description: Tavily AI-optimized web search. Returns clean, citation-ready text snippets and a relevance-ranked list of results. Use for any current/recent information, news, prices, weather, research questions, or anything requiring live web data.

tools.name: tavily_search
tools.short_description: Search the public web for current information - returns ranked {title, url, content, score} results
tools.description: Search the public web via Tavily. Use whenever the user asks about current events, news, prices, weather, recent research, or anything that requires up-to-date information not in the model's training data. Returns a list of results with title, URL, content snippet, and relevance score. For fetching a specific known URL, prefer tavily_extract instead. For mapping the structure of a website, prefer tavily_map. For deep multi-source research with citations, use tavily_research.

query.description: The search query (1-400 chars). Be specific and include relevant qualifiers (location, date, version).

max_results.description: Maximum number of results to return (1-20).

include_answer.description: Include a Tavily-generated short answer (synthesized from the top results) in the response.

include_raw_content.description: Include the full extracted text of each result page (not just the snippet). Increases response size significantly.

include_domains.description: Optional: restrict results to these domains (e.g. ['wikipedia.org', '.gov']). Use for trusted-source queries.

returns.description: Search results with query, ranked results array, optional answer, and timing info
